sloka: कैकेय्या क्लिश्यमानेन राज्ञा सम्चोदितः वनम् ।परित्राता जनस्य अस्य जगतः क्व नु गच्चति ॥२-४१-५॥
transliteration: kaikeyyā kliśyamānena rājñā samcoditaḥ vanam ।paritrātā janasya asya jagataḥ kva nu gaccati ॥2-41-5॥

translations.english: Tormented by Kaikeyi, the king ordered him to go to the forest. Where is he, who happened to be the protector of the people of this world, going now?
